measurement: Portable local transcript replay using deterministic scoring; no provider calls.

initial_discovery.selection: Exclude recently active files (<180 seconds by modification time), unavailable/zero usage, files over 128 MiB and invalid JSONL. Deterministic hash ranking; one candidate per observed ancestor family per provider/cohort. Caps: 512 high-context and 64 below-trigger Codex; all eligible Claude families above the trigger and 16 controls. No selection by compaction result.

archived_codex_roots.root_definition: Recognized root source metadata and no parent, fork or subagent metadata. This is a metadata classification, not proof of absent undisclosed ancestry.
archived_codex_roots.selection: Regular owned non-symlink files, at most 128 MiB, older than 180 seconds, complete valid object JSONL and positive provider usage after the latest native boundary. One candidate per root identity, exact event-body deduplication, deterministic hash ranking. All eligible high-context roots up to 512 plus up to 64 controls. No replacement after freeze-time exclusions; no selection by compaction result.
archived_codex_roots.audit_correction: Source metadata reclassification identified 4,656 excluded files as explicit subagents; selected roots and frozen bytes were unchanged.

analysis.no_op_handling: No-plan cases remain in reduction denominators as zero reduction; failures are reported separately.
analysis.usage_denominator: Latest provider usage after the live native boundary was checked against the measured binary normalized context. All selected sessions matched; no primary numerical exclusions were needed.
analysis.native_compaction: Counts include historical native records; reduction concerns the current live context, not all transcript bytes.
analysis.overlap: Cross-cohort session identity and exact event-body checks found no overlap. The earlier six-root convenience pilot is excluded.
analysis.structural: Compare baseline and rewritten verifier severity/code counts; not provider resume qualification.
analysis.recall: Bounded deterministic literal probes. No semantic importance, answer accuracy or task outcome is established.
analysis.privacy: Only aggregate results and methodology are public. Raw inputs and per-session metadata remain private, so the exact corpus cannot be independently replayed from these downloads.

limitations: One person and one Mac; sessions may share prompts, projects or unobserved ancestry.
No provider continuation, billing, semantic judge or remote model was evaluated.
The measured extractor had a nominal 64-probe cap but could emit 65–67 probes; the reported denominators are actual counts.
Structural deltas compare severity/code counts, not finding identity or proof of safe provider resume.
Resampling intervals describe the selected stratum only; they are not population confidence intervals.
Cohort strata overlap: do not add native-compacted, no-native-compaction and no-observed-parent rows together.
The 128 MiB input bound excludes some long tasks and may bias the distribution.
Modification time is an activity heuristic, not a process-liveness guarantee.
